# security

plinths act on blocks, containers and items next to them, so security here covers protection bypasses as well as crashes.

## what to report privately

- a way to break, place, harvest or take items from a claimed or protected area through a plinth, when the player who set it up could not do that themselves.
- duplicating or deleting items, fluids, energy or experience, or corrupting saved plinth or channel data.
- crashing or hanging a server from a client.
- a malformed or abusable packet.

ordinary bugs, crashes on your own machine and feature ideas go in a normal issue.

## how to report

use github's private reporting: the security tab, then "report a vulnerability" ([report one here](https://github.com/cinderworks-mc/plinthworks/security/advisories/new)). please don't open a public issue or post details in chat.

include the minecraft, neoforge and plinthworks versions, the other mods you run, numbered steps, and the log if you have one. take your player name, ip address and the user name in file paths out of it first.

if that page isn't available to you, open a plain issue that only says you have a security report and want to be contacted. the details can move somewhere private from there.

## what to expect

this is a small hobby project. a first reply usually comes within a week, and fixes for confirmed protection bypasses and duplication go in before new features. please give it a fair amount of time before you publish a problem.

## supported versions

only the newest release for minecraft 1.21.1.
